params.message:
Write down the handover graph's topology as version 1.0

docs/topology.md describes the nodes, edges, properties and knowledge
of the graph and how versions move; App\Graph\Topology is the registry
the code reads. Notes are stamped with the version they were written
against, the graph data carries it, and the handover CSV gains the
anchor, source and version per row.
